proposals.evidence: Turner lists Punjabi/Lahnda lammā/lambā, West Pahari lammo/lammā, Gujarati lā̃bũ and Oriya lambā; the addendum explicitly gives West Koci lɔmbo. These whole long adjectives fit that nasal or nasal-stop family and its ordinary agreement forms. The Kullu length noun lambāi and extended -la/-ḍa forms are excluded.
